title: Thinking in Language
description: Additive B2–C1 curriculum layer for reusable reasoning language. Existing study sets remain unchanged.

phases.focus: frame problems, calibrate uncertainty, reason about systems, and make decisions
diagnose causes, test explanations, take perspectives, and learn from feedback

principles: Add new useful sets instead of deleting established curriculum.
A thinking Frame must be both natural language and a reusable reasoning operation.
English and German Frames include Russian learner-support translations.
Reasoning metadata should improve retrieval and relation discovery without replacing the canonical language examples.
Frozen evaluation surfaces remain frozen; curriculum growth must not rewrite historical benchmark claims.
